name: Encroaching Gnolls
summary: Gnolls have reached the western road into Redridge, and Lakeshire fears being cut off. Guard Parker spots camps near the border and sends word to Deputy Feldon. The warning confirms the town’s fear that the beastmen may isolate Redridge.

sections.title: Eyes on the Border
sections.body: Guard Parker watches the western border trail, where the road runs from Elwynn Forest into Redridge Mountains. Stormwind’s forces have thinned, leaving the route with few defenders. Parker keeps the gravel road open for supply wagons, but his scouts find gnoll warbands advancing from the crags to the north and east. Their camps lie alarmingly close to the road.

sections.title: A Town Under Siege
sections.body: Deputy Feldon receives the warning near the Lakeshire bridge and sees how much danger the town faces. Redridge gnolls are raiding near Lakeshire, and their camps near the Elwynn border could let them encircle the town and push into the kingdom’s heartland. Stormwind has ignored pleas for reinforcements, leaving Lakeshire’s watch unready for threats from both sides.

faq.answer: Guard Parker gives you the warning along the road in western Redridge Mountains, near the Elwynn Forest border crossing.

faq.q: Where can I find Deputy Feldon?
faq.answer: Deputy Feldon is in Lakeshire, patrolling the grounds just south of the town’s large stone bridge.

faq.q: Why are the gnolls an issue on the road?
faq.answer: The road to Elwynn Forest is Lakeshire’s only safe land route to the rest of the kingdom. If gnolls take the western slopes, the town could lose its supplies and its way out.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind send help to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing and unrest straining the realm, Highlord Bolvar and the court have refused to send royal troops to Redridge. Lakeshire must rely on local deputies and volunteers for its defense.

faq.q: What happens after reporting the gnolls?
faq.answer: Deputy Feldon asks you to scout the gnoll camps more closely in Assessing the Threat, to learn how many gnolls have gathered.

faq.q: Which gnoll packs are encroaching here?
faq.answer: Redridge gnolls gather in the hills as the Redridge Gnoll Pack. As human control of the region weakens, they have grown bolder and more coordinated.

angles.text: As a human, you can see how the beastmen’s advance near Elwynn Forest leaves the kingdom’s heart vulnerable while the king is missing.
As an Alliance traveler, you know Lakeshire’s isolation threatens the eastern front, making border intelligence vital for travelers and supply convoys.
